It would be easy for a lazy actor awaiting their cue to use those periods of silence to go over their list of things to do the next day or decide where to go for dinner after the show.”

However:
 
“... as every good actor knows, LISTENING is the key to a credible performance. But it’s not a lesson that every actor learns.”

Michael Caruana

“Michael has created a safe space for young actors to grow and challenge themselves. Sophia has taken part in many workshops, programs, scene studies and private coaching sessions over the years with Michael, and has developed a genuine trusting relationship with him, allowing her to let her guard down and be vulnerable, which is so important and can be very difficult to achieve, especially when working with a teen. She always loves her time working with him as he truly knows how to bring out the best in her, challenging her and encouraging her. He has been such an amazing mentor to both Sophie and I as we were figuring out how the industry works, always having her best interests at heart. Whenever she has an important audition, she turns to Michael for support, advice and coaching in how to do her best work for each new role she is working towards. His belief in her and her potential have been truly transformative for her as an actor and as a young woman and we are so lucky to have him on our team.”

Isabelle Kunicki, Founder and Director at The Clover School, Toronto 

Come train with actor and coach, Michael Caruana. Expert guidance and coaching, trusted, since 1996, at bongo productions. 

Private Coaching.
Scene-study.
Audition Technique

Comprehensive training with our Certificate Program.

Michael Caruana offers you real tools and support. It’s getting busier again and you want to keep your acting tools sharp.

CASTING CALL — FAST MONEY

Kin & Conflict Films is casting for TEE in our upcoming pilot presentation / short film, FAST MONEY.

ROLE: TEE | SUPPORTING
Woman | 25–35
African, Black, Hispanic, Indigenous, Mixed Ethnicity, or West Indies/Caribbean

Tee is charismatic, street-smart, confident, calculated, and mysterious. She lives a flashy lifestyle and carries herself with effortless confidence. She can walk into a room and command everyone’s attention without saying a word. But beneath the glamour, confidence, and mystery, there’s much more to Tee than meets the eye.

Location: Austell, GA
Must be a local hire
Approximately 2-day shoot

COMPENSATION & PERKS
This is an unpaid production. Selected talent will receive: 

• Meals provided during filming
• IMDb credit
• A copy of footage for personal reel/portfolio use

Oct. 9 — Casting Decision
Oct. 11 — Table Read

items.text:
**CASTING NOTICE**

Non-Equity Call; $50/performance

Trinity Theatre Company is seeking actors to fill all roles for *POTUS* by Selina Fillinger, directed by Kandace Crystal and performing January 8-17, 2027. Also seeking actors to fill most roles in the world premier of The House Between by Serhat Pala, directed by Sean Boyd and performing February 26 - March 14, 2027.

**Auditions:** In-Person appointments on October 20th. Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue of your choice. Submissions are being taken online through [Sign Up Genius](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions). All submissions must be submitted through this platform. ([https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions))

Prior to auditions, you will be emailed to submit a *digital *copy of your headshot & resume. Hard copies are not required, and will not be taken.

**Important Dates for *****POTUS***:

December 1 – First Rehearsal

December 29 - January 7 – Tech

January 8 - January 17 – Performances

****Break for Christmas Week and New Year Holidays****

**Important Dates for *****The House Between***:

January 12 – First Rehearsal

February 16-25 – Tech

February 26 - March 14 – Performances

**Location:**

All Rehearsals & Performances will take place at the Trinity Theatre Company, 9520 Padgett Street, Suite 208, San Diego, CA 92126

Rehearsals Tuesdays - Fridays from 6p-10p.

Performances Fridays & Saturdays at 7p; Sundays at 2p.

**Character Breakdown:**

****Actors of all ethnicities, race, age, and gender are encouraged to apply****

POTUS:

HARRIET - His Chief of Staff

JEAN - His press secretary

STEPHANIE - His secretary

DUSTY - His dalliance

BERNADETTE - His sister

CHRIS - A journalist

MARGARET - His wife. The First Lady.

THE HOUSE BETWEEN:

CHRISSY -Greek–Australian. 50s–60s.

A painter and mother living in Melbourne. Warm, witty, and emotionally brave beneath a practiced competence. Carries the “unfinished story” of her grandfather and a restless need to stand inside the place it began.

JOHN -Chrissy’s son. Late 20s–30s.

Protective, skeptical, articulate. Thinks structurally (risk, logistics, consequences). His love often arrives as interrogation first, tenderness second.

ATHENA -Chrissy’s daughter. 20s

Bright, affectionate, and perceptive. The first to offer warmth, the quickest to name what’s happening in the room; often the bridge between generations.

HAKAN -Turkish–American. 50s–60s.

An academic (a professor). Disciplined, cerebral, private; until the right silence breaks him open. He’s spent a lifetime explaining history; now he has to live inside it. His emotional center is steadier than he expects.

ARDA - THIS ROLE HAS BEEN CAST - Hakan’s son. 20s.

Startup founder building AI; ambitious, fast, sincere. Wants speed and scale, but still shows up when family becomes real. Capable of surprising gentleness. Special connection to father, almost the Hakan that could have been.

SAM -Hakan’s longtime friend. 50s–60s.

Semi-retired executive / mentor type. Warm, dry, and socially fluent; he can defuse tension without minimizing it. A steady witness - sometimes a referee, sometimes a catalyst.

IRFAN -Local fixer/contractor/paperwork operator. 40s–50s.

An indispensable “solver” who sells solutions and then invents them. Big-hearted, opportunistic, funny without being a clown. Carries a tape measure like a sword. Wants to be essential (and paid). Often the play’s pressure-valve, but with real stakes underneath. Not meant to be a cartoonish character with more substance than quickly visible on the surface.

METIN - Local falcon enthusiast / informal guide. Age flexible (30s–70s).

Arrives with tea and an overstuffed “logbook” energy. Speaks in folk-poetic metaphor that lands more deeply than he intends. Slightly mystical, slightly practical, like the town itself.

*About the Shows:*

***POTUS - ***One four-letter word is about to rock 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue. When the President unwittingly spins a PR nightmare into a global crisis, the seven brilliant and beleaguered women he relies upon most risk life, liberty, and the pursuit of sanity to keep the commander-in-chief out of trouble.

***The House Between ***- “The House Between” is about two immigrants drawn to the same ruined house from opposite histories. Chrissy, a Greek-Australian artist, and Hakan, a Turkish-American historian, meet in Ayvalık, Türkiye, and begin a late-in-life love story shaped by memory, family, and displacement. The play asks: when you carry more than one home inside you, how do you choose where you belong?

items.text:
🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 24 lata

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna o wyrazistej twarzy i ciemnych włosach. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny, ale jednocześnie ciepły i rodzinny.

Ważna naturalność i swoboda przed kamerą.

Kobieta — 19 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna ekranowa osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 70–80 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.

Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach życia: 1968 / 1972 / 1975 / 1980, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.

Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

Kobieta o ciepłej, klasycznej urodzie i charakterystycznej twarzy.

Kobieca, elegancka, rodzinna, naturalna.

Postać również pokazujemy w różnych okresach – lata 60., 70. i 80.

Ważna umiejętność wiarygodnego przechodzenia między różnymi etapami życia i stylami epoki.

Kobieta — 40–50 lat

Ciepła, zadbana, atrakcyjna kobieta o naturalnym wyglądzie.

Typ: współczesna mama – silna, troskliwa, rodzinna.

Naturalna mimika i wiarygodność przed kamerą ważniejsze niż „modelowy” wygląd.

Mężczyzna — 45–55 lat

Zadbany, męski, naturalny mężczyzna. Krótkie ciemne włosy, możliwy lekki zarost.

Typ: spokojny, pracowity, rodzinny tata.

Szukamy naturalności, ciepła i wiarygodności, bez przesadnie „reklamowego” wizerunku.

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Wizytówka lub/i demo (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

items.text:
Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

sharedPost.text:
Mein neues Musikvideo ist fertig: „Words We Left Unsaid“.

Eigentlich sollte es ein Musikvideo werden. Während der Arbeit daran ist daraus immer mehr ein kleiner Film geworden – über zwei Menschen, Nähe und Distanz, Erinnerungen und all die Worte, die unausgesprochen bleiben.

Musik, Text und Gesang stammen von mir; produziert und eingespielt habe ich den Song in meinem eigenen Studio. Die Bilder und Videosequenzen habe ich mit KI für die Geschichte gestaltet und anschließend im Videoprogramm zum fertigen Film zusammengesetzt und dort Sound-Effekte ergänzt.

Hier könnt ihr ihn direkt ansehen. Am besten mit Ton – und vielleicht bis ganz zum Schluss (Cliffhänger!). 😉

Wenn euch das Video gefällt: Auf meinem YouTube-Kanal „Molle am Sax“ findet ihr meine Musik und weitere Videos. Den Link zum Kanal findet ihr hier:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRdS2Z7fNvwy1dmAxE1kH_w

Mich würde besonders interessieren: Wie interpretiert ihr das Ende?

Den der har bedt mig prøve denne luftstegte sprøde blomkål... det skylder jeg dig seriøst
Disse små bidder kom SÅ sprøde ud udenpå, perfekt møre indeni, og den sauce? Det tager alt til et helt nyt niveau. Det føles ærligt talt, som om jeg spiser noget meget mere overbærende, end det faktisk er!

Jeg blev ved med at gå tilbage for "bare en mere", og pludselig... var hele batchen væk

Advarsel: meget vanedannende. Fortsæt med forsigtighed

Sig "Hej", og jeg sender dig hele opskriften

🎭 **ALTERNATE SHADOWS – WHAT A NIGHT!** 🎭

On Saturday, Alternate Shadows performed at the fundraising event **“Murder They Wrote”** at **St Augustine’s Church in Gillingham**.

Many of us have driven past this lovely building on the corner of Rock Avenue on the way to Medway Hospital, but have you ever been inside? 👀

This was our first visit to **St Augustine’s Church**, which dates from **1916** and is the only church in South East England designed by Victorian architect **Temple Moore**.

Originally a Mission Church, the building was established on the site in 1911 and was known locally as the **“Iron Church.”** It was later brick-clad and reroofed to create the present church hall.

We really enjoyed performing in such a fascinating and historic setting! ❤️

**OUR NEXT PERFORMANCE**

Our next performance is a private booking for U3A in Gravesend on Saturday, so the **next public performance** you can come along to is:

**SATURDAY 10th OCTOBER**
**Vigo Village Hall, Vigo**

**Tickets:**
Family £25 | Adults £10 | Seniors £7.50 | Children £5

📞 **07854 500015**

**MURDER THEY WROTE**

It’s **1953**, and a collection of murder-mystery novelists arrive at an elegant country house hotel, each expecting to be the guest of a prestigious publisher.

But something isn’t quite right…

Before long, they discover that **nothing — and nobody — is quite what they seem.**

There’s a crime to solve.
There are secrets to uncover.
There are plenty of suspects.
And, naturally… **everyone has something to hide!** 🕵️‍♀️🔎

The question is…

**WHO committed the crime?**

And perhaps more importantly…

**WHO WILL BE NEXT?** 😱

Come along and see if you can work out whodunit! 🎭🔍

#AlternateShadows #MurderTheyWrote #MurderMystery #LiveTheatre #Vigo #VigoVillageHall #Gillingham #CommunityTheatre #WhatsOn

Jigsaw Casting Ltd. Is Seeking Cigarette Smokers ages 30+ across Canada who have cut back or are trying to quit for a ZONNIC Testimonial Campaign!

We are looking for the following people:
1. Individuals who are actively quitting or cutting back with ZONNIC. You are currently using the product and able to speak to it first-hand.

2. Individuals who are looking to quit or cut back — and you are open to trying ZONNIC. You are motivated to change the habit, not yet a ZONNIC user. You are open to trying the product ahead of the shoot.

3. Individuals who have tried other NRTs without success — open to switching. Those who have attempted to quit with other nicotine replacement therapies that did not work.

4. Individuals who have recently quit by using ZONNIC.

If selected – This is a compensated, non-union project, with total potential compensation of up to $5,100.00 per person, depending on final usage and survival of the edit. Buyout includes all lifts, edits and versions for a 1 year period.

Requirements
• Aged 30+ and visually read as 30+ on camera.
• Resides in Canada. Everyday Canadians from diverse backgrounds
• Currently smokes and is either cutting back or looking to quit, able to describe it unprompted.
• Comfortable speaking honestly and being publicly attributed.

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT - ASAP OR BEFORE OCTOBER 7, 2026 AT 9AM EST.
You must be available for these dates if selected:

Recall: October 16 via in person (Montreal) or zoom (other cities).

Shoot: 1 day in between Nov 19 to 30. Location TBD: Either in Montreal, Toronto or Vancouver. Travel and accommodation will be provided if you don't live close to the studio in one of those cities. Travel dates will be 1 or 2 days before the shoot.

If interested, you must apply and submit a self tape to:
https://zonniccampaign.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:
1. Introduce yourself.
2. What makes you want to quit or cut back?
3. What personal goals is ZONNIC helping you unlock?

items.text:
Hi everyone,
We’re excited to announce the FITS Modelling Boot Camp – Building the Foundations for High Fashion, taking place this October in London.

Whether you’re new to modelling or looking to strengthen your skills, this workshop is designed to give you practical guidance, hands-on experience and insight into the foundations of high fashion modelling.

Throughout the day, you’ll take part in:

• Industry Talk – Hear real experiences from a model on breaking into high fashion, castings and runway, followed by an open Q&A.

• Posing Coaching – Learn about body angles, posture, expression and editorial posing, with guided practice and feedback.

• Runway & Movement Coaching – Develop your walk, posture, pacing, turns and presence, with individual practice.

• Digitals Session – Learn what agencies look for in model digitals and take part in a live shoot, receiving a headshot, full-body front and side shots, and a profile shot.

• Confidence & Casting Guidance – Receive feedback and practical tips on self-presentation and continuing to develop after the workshop.

• Networking – Connect with other aspiring models and creatives within the fashion industry.

📅 17 October 2026

📍 Method Studio, Greenwich, London

⏰ 1:00 PM – 5:30 PM

🎟️ Book your place: 

https://www.eventbrite.com/e/fits-modelling-bootcamp-tickets-2001389683419

Come ready to learn, practise, connect and build the foundations for your modelling journey.

We look forward to seeing you there!

FITS Magazine

A home for fashion

**PAID, London, models needed for TOMORROW**
We're nearly full for our clothing fitting session but still need a handful of specific sizes. No modelling experience needed, you just stand there while we see how the clothes fit. Small friendly team, professional studio, relaxed.

Only comment if you're within a few pounds and an inch of one of these:

WOMEN

5'2", 160 lbs

5'2", 170 lbs

5'2", 222 lbs

5'3", 176 lbs

5'4", 160 lbs

5'4", 175 lbs

5'5", 249 lbs

5'6", 225 lbs

5'8", 225 lbs

MEN

5'0", 145 lbs

5'9", 150 lbs

5'9", 200 lbs

Two parts, you need to be free for both:

Day 1: Tomorrow (Wednesday), Clerkenwell. A 45 minute slot for measurements and a couple of reference photos. £50.

Day 2: Friday 9 October, Belgravia. The fitting itself, up to around 4 hours. £25 per hour.

I'm confirming today, first come first served. Comment or DM your height, weight and I'll send your slot straight back.

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

———————————

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

https://cinema.usc.edu/events/event.cfm?id=73397

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

———————————

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

 • October 7 at USC – Free registration：

https://cinema.usc.edu/events/event.cfm?id=73397

 • October 9 at UCLA – Free registration：

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

 • October 10 public screening at The Culver Theater – Tickets available for purchase：

https://web.theculvertheater.com/films/Were-Nothing-At-All/HO00000747

——————————————

Media inquiries: 

info@blacklight-global.com

——————————————-

Zostało jeszcze kilka ról do obsadzenia w Trudnych Sprawach.
W tym jedna rola pierwszoplanowa!

1. Tomasz 45-54 lat 
Terminy zdjęć: 1,2,3 październik.
Typ: Przystojny.
Historia. Ukrywa przed córką bogactwo wygrane w Totka. 
Do czasu kiedy córka ukończy studia. 
Natomiast córka podejrzewa rodziców o prowadzenie szemranych interesów.
Wymagania: Prawo jazdy oraz duże doświadczenie na planie.

2. Pani Lusia między 65-80 lat.
Jedna scena. Także proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 1.10
Od 7 do 8 rano.

3. Atrakcyjna kobieta 
Wiek około 20-26 lat 
Terminy zdjęć: 3 październik.
Od 8:30 do 10:00
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.

4. 3 atrakcyjne kobiety statystowanie
Wiek około 30-40 lat 
Terminy zdjęć: 3 październik.
Od 8:00 do 9:30
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.

Wygrodzenie płatne gotówką na planie 

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o koment Pod postem lub w wiadomości priv z informacją ile lat, skąd oraz czy ma się już jakieś doświadczenie na planie zdjęciowym.

Wynagrodzenie płatne gotówką na planie po zakończeniu zdjęć. Zdjęcia odbędą się we Wrocławiu, a dla osób spoza Wrocławia zwracam koszty podróży oraz zapewniam hotel.

Osoby zainteresowane historią odcinka, wynagrodzeniem oraz informacją jak wziąć udział w castingu zapraszam do kontaktu na priv, bądź komentarz pod postem :)

Zgłoszenia można również wysyłać na emial adres 
adrian.zarzecki@polotmedia.pl z informacją wiek, jakie doświadczenie na planie, aktualne zdjęcia i numer tel 728070579

sharedPost.text:
Blackpool’s original 1920s cinema The Regent is playing host to an international festival of short films which is normally staged in Manchester.

The white tiled Art Deco cinema, on the corner of Church Street and Regent Road, will welcome the special 10th anniversary edition of ‘From the Vaults’ on Saturday October 3, from 7pm.

Among the films being shown is the latest opus from Fylde coast filmmaker Anton Arenko, a quirky and warm-hearted release called Malcolm’s Subject.

This documentary follows Malcolm Wilson, a former campsite owner who after closing his site, sought human contact through his pursuit of UFOs and other phenomena.

Anton, whose other films included a tribute piece to the Fleetwood to Knott End Ferry, called End to End, launched a crowdfunding appeal to get Malcolm’s Subject wrapped up, and was delighted when the campaign raised the £1,200.

This year’s From the Vaults festival will feature a dozen short indie films from around the world.

Festival organiser Andy Green said: “Our Manchester indie film night is coming to Blackpool as part of our 10th birthday celebrations.

“Everyone is welcome to come along to view the indie films, there will be filmmakers there talking about their work, we will have networking time and time available for people to talk about their projects in the works or ideas for next year.

“Due to the age of this building, my apologies but there is no lift upto the seating area. Please be mindful that you will be able to get up to the seating area.”

Anton, who worked with cinematographer Iain Cash on his latest film, said: “I’ve been going to this festival to see these films for years, so to have a film of my own involved is brilliant, especially in a venue such as The Regent.

“I’d like to thank everyone who helped me make my film possible. It should be a brilliant night.”

Tickets cost £5 and and can be obtained via the visit Film Vault Presents Facebook page or on the door.

🎄 CHRISTMAS ELF CASTING – 2026 GROTTO CONTRACT 🎄
We're casting for our magical Christmas Grottos across the UK – and we’re on the lookout for charismatic, professional Christmas Elves to join the team!

📆 Contract: November – December 2026
💸 Rate: Varies per venue, TBC via email 

📍 Locations: 
* Harlestone Heath - Northampton
* Newbridge – Horsham

✨ Requirements:
• Entry-level acting skills
• Basic script work and immersive performance ability
• Confident group singing of children’s Christmas songs

🧝‍♀️ We’re looking for:
• Confident, energetic performers with great improvisation skills
• Friendly, reliable team players
• Previous experience working with children or in character-based roles is a plus

📌 Important Info:
• Costume and full training provided
• Paid rehearsals and site visits will be scheduled in early November – exact dates TBC

Szukamy osoby w wieku 40+ (lub wyglądającej na ten wiek), która wcieli się w rolę nauczyciela. W krótkich filmach (30s) będzie w przystępny sposób tłumaczyć innym zagadnienia.

🎥Na czym polega współpraca?

•Nagrywamy krótkie scenki publikowane na Instagramie i Facebooku
•Nie musisz uczyć się kwestii na pamięć
•Nagrania minimum raz na 2 tygodnie, w terminie ustalanym wspólnie
•Jedno spotkanie trwa ok. 3 h (przygotowanie + ok. 2 h nagrań)
•Studio w Katowicach lub Zabrzu
•100 zł za każdą godzinę spędzoną z nami, czyli za 3-godzinne spotkanie otrzymujesz 300 zł

💼Jak wygląda start?

Zaczynamy od dwóch płatnych próbnych spotkań. Jeśli współpraca będzie się dobrze układać, proponujemy stałą współpracę na rok. Formę umowy ustalimy indywidualnie.

✔️ Kogo szukamy?
Kobiety lub mężczyzny 40+
Osoby naturalnej i swobodnej przed kamerą z pozytywną energią
Doświadczenie aktorskie - niewymagane

📌Jak się zgłosić?
Wyślij na maila Oliwia.manager@gmail.com

•Krótki filmik, w którym opowiesz kilka słów o sobie
•Swój numer telefonu

*Nie musisz się specjalnie przygotowywać. Po prostu weź telefon do ręki i nagraj kilka słów o sobie.

⏳ Zależy nam na czasie, więc wyślij zgłoszenie jak najszybciej! Z wybranymi osobami skontaktujemy się telefonicznie.

One performer. No script. Nothing to hide behind.

On Saturday, 3 October, Inbal Lori steps onto the stage alone.

From that moment on, everything is created live.

Every character. Every relationship. Every twist in the story. Every unexpected moment that makes the room laugh, go quiet, or suddenly feel something nobody planned.

The audience gives the spark. Inbal builds the world.

For one night in Warsaw, you get to watch an extraordinary improviser create an entire performance from nothing, right in front of you. And when the night is over, it disappears.

That exact show will never exist again.

If you love improv, you already know how special that can be. If you have never seen solo improv before, this is a beautiful place to start.

Saturday, 3 October 2026
Doors: 19:30
Show: 20:00

Warsaw A&O Wola

Seats are limited.

Organized by Impact Warsaw

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

Vi har modtaget overvældende mange henvendelser, og ser os derfor nødsaget til at lukke for yderligere henvendelser. Tusinde tak for interesssen. 

Vi søger statister til en stor øvelse som afholdes med beredskabsinstanserne i København. 

Rollerne går ud på at spille pårørende til tilskadekomne, nysgerrige journalister, turister og lignende karakterer man kunne se ved en stor ulykke. 

Des mere man kan leve sig ind i en rolle og gør sceneriet virkelighedsnært, jo bedre. Og man skal gerne være i stand til at improvisere.

Man vil skulle spille rollerne foran reelt politi, brandvæsen, og paramediciner. 

Filmen er udelukkende til internt brug.

Optagelserne finder sted den onsdag 28. Oktober 2026 med mødested Nordre Tolbod 29, København fra klokken 10:00 til 13:00 med kaffe og kage efter. 

Jobbet er ulønnet, men vi honorerer indsatsen med et gavekort til en rundflyvning over København med vandflyveren. 

Vi garanterer for en spændende og sjov dag. 

Send venligst pb ved interesse, og jeg vender tilbage snarest muligt. 

Med venlig hilsen
Lauda Waldof
Statist koordinator.

**TVILLINGER SØGES TIL P3 SATIRE**

P3 Satire søger et tvillingepar, der ligner hinanden, til en sketch for P3 Satire med vært, Adnan Al-Adhami. 

Optagelsen foregår i DR Byen i København i morgen, fredag d. 25, kl. 9.00 og tager ca. 30 minutter. Der gives et honorar på 500 kr. pr. person. 

Det kræver ikke skuespillererfaring – bare at I er tvillinger og ligner hinanden godt. 

Hvis det lyder som jer, så send en sms til mig på 40 21 18 73, med et billede af jer begge. Del meget gerne opslaget med nogen, der kunne være relevante! :) 

Mvh Karoline Juul

40 21 18 73

DR P3 Satire

NEW HOLLYOAKS COURSE
still places available 
We are excited to announce our next 4-week Hollyoaks Adult Acting Course starting this November for actors aged 16+. For the very first time, we will have both Hollyoaks Casting Directors—Peter Hunt and Gill Charnock—in together to watch your performances.
During the final week on 6th December, participants will take part in a mock casting in front of Peter and Gill. They will be giving notes, feedback, and direction on each individual performance. We have had a fantastic success rate from our previous Hollyoaks courses, with past attendees securing auditions and roles after meeting the casting directors.
Course Schedule & Details:
  - Week 1: Saturday 14th November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 2: Saturday 21st November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 3: Saturday 28th November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 4 (Mock Casting): Sunday 6th December 2026, 1pm- 3pm 
Fee: £145
Click here to book:  https://screenplayacting.com/.../hollyoaks-nov-dec-2026.../
Address:
Studio 96, Unit 1A and 1B, Sundance Court
Kansas Avenue, Salford, Media City, M50 2GZ
Please note: We do not offer refunds, but we do offer course transfers. Transfers must be used within a 6-month period

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

🎬 WYNAJMIJ PRZESTRZEŃ — Folwark Motyl

Pałac, młyn, folwark i krajobraz w jednym kadrze — jedna decyzja produkcyjna.

Motyl to nietknięty XIX-wieczny zespół folwarczny z warstwą powojennego PGR-u, położony w Borach Tucholskich nad Sępolenką. Autentyczna faktura, prywatny teren, bez wspólnot i bez pośredników.

Skala, której nie sfilmujesz w studio • 4 362 m² powierzchni budynków · 11,8 ha gruntu • 14 budynków zinwentaryzowanych • 3,5 ha łąk i otwartych pól · ~500 m linii brzegowej rzeki • wyspa 400 m² na rozlewisku · ~1000 m² utwardzonych placów • starodrzew ze 400-letnimi dębami

Co znajdziesz na terenie • Pałac neogotycki — 616 m², trzy kondygnacje plus piwnice (308 m² sklepień). Sień z szachownicową posadzką, piec kaflowy, klatka schodowa, żeliwne belki, odsłonięte warstwy farby. Piwnice o akustyce katedry. • Stary młyn wodny — 568 m², cztery kondygnacje z zachowaną maszynerią: koło zamachowe, żeliwne skrzynie, kamienie młyńskie, rynny grawitacyjne. Cztery poziomy autentyzmu, faktura pyłu mąki i drewna. • Obora PGR — 1 172 m², kolumnowa hala długości niemal 90 m, dwustronny rytm okien, żłoby odlewane w betonie, pusta i gotowa. Zmieści się w niej kompletna scenografia. • Zabudowa historyczna i postindustrialna — stajnia, kuźnia, spichlerz, stodoła, stare obory, szereg 14 garaży z drewnianymi wrotami, hala magazynowo-garażowa 317 m². • Krajobraz — rzeka Sępolenka z odcinkiem leśnym, rozlewisko z wyspą, park dworski, łąki w otoczeniu Borów Tucholskich.

Możliwe użycia: dramat historyczny, film gotycki, horror, editorial fashion, reklama premium, film epoki, steampunk, thriller, teledysk, dystopia, sci-fi, film PRL, serial kryminalny, reklama motoryzacyjna, moda streetwear, baza produkcyjna i pop-up studio.

Logistyka • Dojazd: Bydgoszcz 40 km, Gdańsk 120 km, Poznań 150 km, Warszawa 320 km, Berlin 500 km • Prąd 3-fazowy  · agregat w zasięgu · woda z ujęcia i rzeka na terenie • Sanitariaty na terenie · zaplecze socjalne · miejsce na catering · nocleg w promieniu 15 km • Pozwolenia: teren prywatny — szybka ścieżka, bez wspólnot • Cztery pory roku, zima z pokrywą śnieżną

Zapraszamy na location scout. Przyjedź, obejdź teren, zrób zdjęcia i porozmawiaj o terminach — zwiedzanie umawiamy zwykle w 48 h.

Dla zainteresowanych wyślemy pełny location book w pdf .tel 608-737-803

Osada Motyl — Dom Wolnych Dusz #motyLove #FolwarkMotyl #location #locationscout #planspotograficzny #film #reklama #teledysk #BoryTucholskie #Tuchola

**URGENT CASTING: JIGSAW CASTING IS LOOKING FOR CANADIAN BASED AMERICAN GIRLS AGES 13-16. MUST STILL HAVE AMERICAN ACCENT SOCCER / FOOTBALL PLAYERS WITH GOOD ABILITY**

This is casting in Canada but filming in Brazil. All travel and accommodation are included for talent and one parent.

We are continuing the Dove campaign to keep our girls in sport – and for this project in particular, soccer! For more information: https://bit.ly/doveconfidentsports

Girls are too often being told their bodies are wrong for sports. Too tall. Too short. Too strong. Too soft. We’re not losing girls because they can’t play. We’re losing them because the world tells them their bodies don’t fit the game.

Our film invites us to talk about their first touch, their passes, their shots. We will be filming real football on the pitch, on the street - wherever our girls are playing.

We are looking for 13 - 16 year-old girls ( with American accents) who actively have a high or medium level of football from various positions: goalkeeper; striker; centre, defence.

We are looking for a broader range of body shapes, sizes, abilities, ages, football levels to make sure it’s more universal and inclusive. We want real footballers, with their real bodies.

For this video we are NOT looking for girls that are currently signed with model / acting agencies or that have already taken part in any professional modelling or advertising.

Filming will be in Brazil - which is the venue for next year’s Women’s World Cup – there will be girls from different countries taking part and all travel / hotels for selected girls plus one parent will be arranged and paid for. Such a great opportunity !!

**Must be available for these key dates:**

Callbacks: October 14 or 15, 2026. Via zoom.

Filming / Photography

In November we estimate approx. 5 days to include travel, prep and filming:

Travel: Between November 23 to 25 to Brazil. Return home on November 28, 2026.

Shoot: November 26 and 27, 2026.

Payments come in two parts:

Day rates are paid to the girls confirmed for this project for the actual days booked and generally about 4 - 5 weeks after filming.

DAY RATES: - rates given in Euros as per contract per person.

Travel / Prep etc - 130 euros

Filming - 257.50 euros

Parents (Chaperone ) 100 dollars per day ( not incl callback)

Usages - global all media - 12 months

Hero - speaking talent - 5,500 euros

Supporting/ non featured - 2,750 euros

**Deadline: ASAP or before September 28, 2026 at 10am EST.**

Usage is not guaranteed as it is subject to your appearance in the final live materials, final media plan and paid once these are live – Spring 2027. The planned rates are - global all media - 12 months. We will have a better idea which category your child is in after the callbacks.

If interested, please apply with a self tape to:

https://dovesoccer.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:

https://bit.ly/dovesoccerselftape

items.text:
The Miracle of Sheffield is a new play by acclaimed playwright Jonathan Maitland, starring Thomas Craig. It follows Tom’s journey from a football-loving Sheffield boy to an actor whose life becomes entwined with one of football’s most extraordinary comeback stories.

What we’re looking for
* Strong naturalistic acting ability
* A Sheffield or Yorkshire accent, or the ability to perform one authentically
* Blond or light auburn/ginger hair is desirable

We especially welcome submissions from performers with a connection to Sheffield or South Yorkshire.

Submission and audition process

This is a submission-first casting call. Please email jennifer@miracleofsheffield.com, using the subject line Young Tommy Audition, and include:
* Headshot
* CV
* Age
* Height
* Current location

Only selected applicants will be invited to audition. Invited applicants will receive the audition city, date, time and full venue details before being asked to attend.

All invited auditions will take place in a professionally booked venue.

Paid opportunity/expenses

This is a paid Equity contract at applicable Equity rates. Expenses are covered; exact covered items and reimbursement arrangements will be provided to selected applicants.

Rehearsals take place in London in March 2027.

Please share with suitable young performers, youth theatres, schools and families in your Sheffield and South Yorkshire networks.

#TheMiracleOfSheffield #CastingCall #SheffieldTheatre #YoungActors #YorkshireTheatre #Sheffield #Theatre

*ljude alternativnijeg i "cool" izgleda

* svi izvan traženog profila su također dobrodošli 

𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 će se održati 𝘂 𝗛𝗢𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗨 𝗪𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡 𝗨 𝗭𝗔𝗚𝗥𝗘𝗕𝗨 (𝗞𝗿𝘀̌𝗻𝗷𝗮𝘃𝗼𝗴𝗮 𝟭), u dvorani "ZRINJEVAC" 𝘂 𝗣𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗗𝗝𝗘𝗟𝗝𝗔𝗞 (𝟮𝟴.𝟵.), 𝗨𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗔𝗞 (𝟮𝟵.𝟵.) 𝗶 𝗦𝗥𝗜𝗝𝗘𝗗𝗨 (𝟯𝟬.𝟵.), 𝗼𝗱 𝟭𝟬:𝟬𝟬 𝗱𝗼 𝟭𝟴:𝟬𝟬 𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶.

🎬 CASTING CALL | BERLIN

We are looking for **two actors** for our student short film **PUTZFRAU**, produced as part of our **Beta Project at FilmArche**.

📍 Berlin
🎥 Shooting: **27–29 November 2026**
💰 Unpaid student production

**MALE LEAD | 35–40**

We are looking for someone who presents as **Greek, Spanish, Italian or Southeastern European**, with **dark hair and a medium build**.

The role includes a scene involving physical confrontation, which will be choreographed. Acting experience is welcome but not required.

**FEMALE ROLE | 40–50**

We are looking for a **German woman**, playing age 40–50.
The role has **very little dialogue**.

**ABOUT THE FILM**

After a backbreaking day at work, an immigrant cleaner’s simmering rage overflows when he encounters a wounded German protester who becomes the target of his fury.

The film explores how financial hardship, systemic marginalization and social exclusion can contribute to anger and radicalization.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:

📸 A recent photo
🎭 A short introduction
📅 Your availability for **27–29 November**

📩 **[zelihacenkci@outlook.com](mailto:zelihacenkci@outlook.com)**** OR Facebook DM! **

Previous acting experience is not required.

If you know someone who might be a good fit, please feel free to **share this post or tag them**. Thank you! 🖤

Looking to cast a Japanese female (between 18-25) to play age range 16/17/18yr old front singer of a band (ideally musical but not completely necessary). Needs to be based in London and available to shoot some video content in the next two weeks. Paid opportunity, please get in touch or reply to this post with your portfolio or headshots. No taller than 5ft5.

NEW HOLLYOAKS COURSE
We are excited to announce our next 4-week Hollyoaks Adult Acting Course starting this November for actors aged 16+. For the very first time, we will have both Hollyoaks Casting Directors—Peter Hunt and Gill Charnock—in together to watch your performances.
During the final week on 6th December, participants will take part in a mock casting in front of Peter and Gill. They will be giving notes, feedback, and direction on each individual performance. We have had a fantastic success rate from our previous Hollyoaks courses, with past attendees securing auditions and roles after meeting the casting directors.
Course Schedule & Details:
  - Week 1: Saturday 14th November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 2: Saturday 21st November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 3: Saturday 28th November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 4 (Mock Casting): Sunday 6th December 2026, 1pm- 3pm 
Fee: £145
Click here to book:  https://screenplayacting.com/.../hollyoaks-nov-dec-2026.../
Address:
Studio 96, Unit 1A and 1B, Sundance Court
Kansas Avenue, Salford, Media City, M50 2GZ
Please note: We do not offer refunds, but we do offer course transfers. Transfers must be used within a 6-month period

Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

-   Du kannst dich vor einem begeisterten Publikum präsentieren.

 

Bewerbung:

Sende dein Video inkl. Bilder, sowie eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Person bis spätestens 30.09.2026 an [kulti@turisede.de](mailto:kulti@turisede.de).

Infos zum bereits laufenden Krönum: [https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html](https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html)

 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht bald gemeinsam auf der Bühne im Krönum zu stehen!

items.text:
Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

Du bist auf der Suche nach einer Gesangslehrerin, 
die Professionalität und internationale Erfahrung mitbringt und Dir mit viel Enthusiasmus, Motivation , Energie und Freude das Singen und alles, was dazu gehört, beibringt ?
Dann bist Du hier, bei mir, genau richtig!

Ich freue mich auf genau Dich!

🎬 SZUKAMY DŹWIĘKOWCA Z WŁASNYM SPRZĘTEM (3-4 października, Warszawa) 🎬

Cześć! Szukamy kogoś ze sprzętem dźwiękowym do krótkometrażowego, niezależnego body horroru! 🍷

W filmie główny bohater trafia na tajemniczą domówkę na Bródnie, która powoli staje się mrocznym rytuałem. Reżyseruje Lukasz Sosnowski (jego "Niedaleko pada jabłko" zgarnęło m.in. główną nagrodę na festiwalu WYSOKIE LOTY) 🏆

Projekt non-profit, ale zapewniamy zgraną ekipę i klimatyczny horror.

items.text:
# Someone called it a “cult” because I asked people to communicate, show up, take accountability, build routines, and follow through.

**😂 Y’all… I’m a PRODUCER.**

I do not wait around. I build the plan, find the resources, make the connections, and go to bat for my team.

Look at Issa Rae building *Awkward Black Girl* on YouTube before the networks cared. The work existed first. The audience came next. The industry eventually had to pay attention.

**I am calling in two types of builders:**

• **People in survival mode** who know the current system isn’t sustainable and are hungry enough to help create something better.

• **People who have a little more stability**, capacity, time, or access and are willing to invest some of it into something bigger than themselves.

I’m not pretending everybody has the same amount to give. I’m saying everybody has something to bring to the table. To secure client opportunities in a noisy digital world, we’re going in person, building relationships face to face, and letting our collaborative work prove what we can do.

If you’re bold enough to take a real chance on yourself and your community, let’s execute.

Which type of builder are you? Drop a comment!. Let’s meet in real life and build.
